items.title: 68728_Jonah
items.q: And I also knew the part on the stage that Howard Roberts had.

ctx.x: And I also knew the part on the stage that Howard Roberts had. You know, he had a trumpet part. He'd go out there and play a little jazz (Singing). Well, I would come out of the pit in the Ziegfield and go up on the stage and do that. And I even made them guys pay me for that, because they come up and said, 'Can you do that?' I said, 'Yeah.' He said, 'Well, okay, we'll give you $25.00 more.' I said, 'Uh-uh. You can get Bill Dillard. He can do that.' I knew they had got to pay him scale, you know. And finally they…

next -- uh-uh. So Delaunay had told me everything, you know, that's how come I like him so much. Said, "Don't be going out there and working cheap and everything, because you come over here, you get straight, go on home. That's where so many of them make a mistake. Go home, and then when you come back again, maybe you can get your money again. But if you stay here it's got to go down." I wound up helping some of them guys out over there.
